title: coord.py events: closed-field, reference-only messages and a wait that wakes any agent
goal: coord.py post --kind K --field NAME=VALUE (repeatable) adds an event to the store, printing its sequence number as seq, and coord.py wait --since N --timeout S returns the events after sequence N, blocking until one arrives or the timeout ends; the kinds are a closed list (claim, release, fact_added, gap_opened, dup_of, lesson, heartbeat) and each event carries only fields of ids (source ids, path:line fact keys, QK answer ids, backlog item ids, pack handles), so post refuses free text over a short field limit and any unknown kind with exit 2; a waiting process of any agent wakes on a post from another process on the same store.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T="_tools/coord.py"
if not os.path.isfile(T):print("coord.py missing: the work adds it");sys.exit(1)
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"coord.sqlite"))
def c(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
unknown=c("post","--kind","chat","--field","item=ST-aaaaaaaa")[0]
free=c("post","--kind","lesson","--field","note="+"free text that tells a story "*20)[0]
r,o,_=c("post","--kind","fact_added","--field","fact=kb/public/agents/a2a-protocol.md:12");seq=json.loads(o).get("seq")
w=s.Popen([sys.executable,T,"wait","--since",str(seq),"--timeout","20"],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.PIPE,text=True,env=E)
time.sleep(1);t0=time.monotonic();c("post","--kind","gap_opened","--field","item=ST-bbbbbbbb");out=w.communicate(timeout=30)[0];took=time.monotonic()-t0
t1=time.monotonic();c("wait","--since","999999","--timeout","1");idle=time.monotonic()-t1
res=dict(unknown_kind_exit2=unknown==2,free_text_exit2=free==2,post=r==0 and isinstance(seq,int),
 woke_on_other_process="ST-bbbbbbbb" in out and "kb/public/agents/a2a-protocol.md:12" not in out and took<10,timeout_ends=idle<5)
print(res);sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)
